turn_text: With regard to payment limits, Senator Grassley again wanted to see some change. The Senate plan was different than that of the House, the House a bit more liberal and who might be able to receive funds. How was it that the House bill or the House proposal made it to the final language?

So it was a different circumstance with regard to payment limitations. There are a lot of folks in trouble, not only small farmers, not only small farming operations or specialty crops or whatever, but you have especially down south and out west where people are involved in lots of acres and a lot of expense. I think that's perfectly understandable in the dramatic situation that we find ourselves in with You've got to have access to technology and everything else. That's very costly.
